concerns.text: FR-002 (Welch's t-test) and FR-003 (Bonferroni) lack implementation tasks. T018, T019, and T020 are marked as unchecked/missing in the task list, leaving the core statistical analysis requirements unimplemented.

FR-005 (Sensitivity Analysis) and FR-006 (MMSE Exclusion robustness) are unmet. T027b, T027c, T028, T029, and T030 are unchecked, meaning the sensitivity sweep and robustness checks defined in the spec are not covered by tasks.

Constitution Principle VI (Stimulus Fidelity) is not covered. T015 (Stimulus Integrity & Generation) and T015a (Metadata) are unchecked, leaving the requirement to store and validate stimuli checksums unimplemented.
Plan element 'Contracts' is unimplemented. T007 (Setup contracts directory) and T020a (Generate Contracts) are unchecked, blocking the schema validation required for data hygiene.
FR-007 (Runtime Monitoring) is unimplemented. T035 is unchecked, meaning the 6-hour timeout warning requirement is not covered by a task.

Stale/Conflicting Tags: T018, T019, T020 are listed as unchecked in the task list but the Analyze Report claims they are 'failed/rejected'. The task list status (unchecked) contradicts the analysis report status (failed), creating ambiguity on whether these tasks exist or are simply incomplete.
